meta.title: `GET /api/event_groups` requires trade read permission
gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /orders, but the supplier app may not call GET /orders (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The invited QA vendor lists events.
As the buyer, list events and check that the read succeeds.
As the invited QA vendor, list events and check that the read answers HTTP 403.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; the read answers HTTP 403.
